name: docs-preview-auto-sync
title: Automate Git-backed documentation preview updates
description: Implement Phase 1 of the approved docs editing roadmap: safe Git polling, fast-forward-only synchronization, cross-process build serialization, and automatic publication to the internal VitePress preview.
creator: wg
notes: Phase 1 is complete on codex/docs-preview-phase1. The server now uses the clean Git checkout /opt/kb-docs-git with a CNB repository deployment token limited to repo-code read-only. kb-docs-preview-sync.timer is enabled and polls every 30 seconds. End-to-end commit 18c23fe was fetched, fast-forwarded, built, health-checked, and published as release 20260811T043851Z-18c23fe-7; the verification marker was confirmed from the LAN URL while the previous release stayed available during the build. The temporary verification page is removed by the completion commit. The original /opt/kb-docs non-Git copy remains available as rollback material.
